verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for intake of GDPR/CCPA deletion or suppression requests, and none for forwarding such requests to connected destinations. CDC sending 'removed rows' is a generic sync behavior, not a privacy-request feature, so it earns no credit. The axis applies to a CDP, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
